title: AWS Step Functions to Amazon SNS
description: Creates a Step Functions workflow that waits before sending an SNS message.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Step Functions receive an execution using the `start-execution` api command with the the message {"waitMilliseconds" : <time-in-milliseconds>} in the input payload.
First the state machine calls a Lambda function to convert milliseconds to seconds.
The state machine will then enter a "Wait" state based on the configuration.
After the wait is complete a message is sent to SNS.
